verdict.rationale: Jan runs models locally with 'full control and privacy' and positions itself as 'Personal Intelligence that answers only to you,' implying local data isn't used for training. However, it also supports connecting to cloud providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.), and there's no explicit policy or documentation addressing data-training opt-out for those cloud paths. Missing for 10: explicit privacy policy or statement on data-training usage, especially for cloud-connected model usage, and independent verification of the no-training claim.
